meaning: Background-auxiliary Galerkin reduced forward prediction, with background-inverse residual enrichment; not an empirical law or zero-computation forecast.
development_seen: All rounds 1/2 and five representative backgrounds at seven conductivities; toy FEM and v0/v1 development diagnostics informed method selection.

initial_sources: unit conductivity perturbation times background field

enrichment.bound: E/(predicted_deltaG-E) when denominator positive, E=r^T K0^{-1} r / DV^2

output.primary: stable positive quadratic energy form, in S

evaluation.relative_error_denominator: abs(COM SOL true increment), threshold 1e-12 S

test_execution_rule: Save all 24 background-only predictions and prediction_batch_ready.json before any independent-test full target solve.

cases.solver_input_guard: candidate_only; passive_ellipse=true is the safe background default; full target must be a separate post-prediction entry
cases.design_description_CN: 固定10 mm几何分区与共同外缓冲，重排内部高低导顺序。
cases.background_high_area_basis: analytic; each sine has zero mean over x=0..120 mm, so each layer area equals width times its reference thickness
cases.interface_expression_geometry_mm: z_j(x) = z_interfaces_mm[j] + interface_amplitudes_mm[j] * sin(2*pi*x/120); x,z in mm

replaced_area_geometry_only.basis: analytic rotated-ellipse vertical strip integral; not COMSOL measurement

cases.finite_endcap_state_basis: The entire cap z ranges are contained in the stated phase; even the largest 1.25 mm wave cannot move a physical interface into either cap.
